thread:
maya: Heads up — automated playbook runs started failing ~12:03 PT. New trial onboarding emails and task creation didn’t fire for a handful of tenants.

alex: Which playbook? any error logs?

maya: Looks like the playbook-runner webhook to CRM is returning 403. Quick log excerpt:

```
2026-03-20T19:03:12Z playbook-runner v2.3.1 ERROR webhook POST https://crm.internal/api/hooks/playbook 403 Forbidden - invalid-token
2026-03-20T19:03:12Z playbook-runner v2.3.1 INFO retrying (1/3)
2026-03-20T19:03:15Z playbook-runner v2.3.1 ERROR webhook POST https://crm.internal/api/hooks/playbook 403 Forbidden - invalid-token
```

cs-bot: ALERT: PLAYBOOK-OPERATOR - serviceaccount token expired for "playbook-operator@redwood-prod" :rotating_light:

rui: That matches a failed credential-sync run I saw earlier during the midnight maintenance window. The sync job crashed pulling the rotated secret.

samira: Midnight rotation? we rotated KMS key last night for prod secrets. Did the sync job have access to the new key?

ken: We rolled the KMS key but forgot to reapply a rolebinding for the playbook-operator service account in the secret-accessor role. credential-sync tried to decrypt and failed with permission denied.

maya: Quick ask — can we hotfix so playbooks resume? We have ~120 open trials that missed welcome emails.

alex: Short term: 1) re-run credential-sync, 2) restart playbook-runner pods, 3) requeue failed playbook events. I can run (3) if someone fixes (1).

rui: I’ll reapply the rolebinding and kick off credential-sync now.

```
# Rui: commands run
kubectl -n infra apply -f rolebinding-playbook-operator.yaml
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/credential-sync
kubectl -n apps rollout restart deployment/playbook-runner
```

rui: credential-sync finished with exit code 0 and secret updated. playbook-operator token valid again.

alex: Running retry for events since 11:30 PT: `redwood-cs playbook-retry --since=1712348400 --limit=1000`

maya: Requeue ran, ~98/120 succeeded immediately, rest are in retry backoff. Monitoring :white_check_mark:. CRM webhook 403s have stopped.

jess: What about healthscore and renewal signals for those accounts? if onboarding tasks didn't run the healthscore might be stale.

alex: Good catch. Many of the playbook actions feed telemetry that triggers healthscore adjustments. Need a recompute for affected tenants. Plan: run a targeted recompute for the 3 tenant IDs listed in the alert and then run a global backfill for events between 11:30-12:15 PT.

ken: I'll create a short-lived job: `cs-healthscore-recompute --tenant=TENANT_ID --from=2026-03-20T11:30:00Z --to=2026-03-20T12:15:00Z` and monitor CPU.

maya: Owners: @ken - healthscore recompute + postmortem section, @rui - validate credential-sync playbooks and add test for KMS rotation, @alex - confirm requeue completeness and alert if any stuck. I'll own customer comms for affected trials.

samira: Can we add a canary for secret rotations in infra? like a smoke job that verifies every rotation by hitting the CRD that credential-sync uses.

ken: yes — propose adding a `rotation-smoke` job that runs right after rotations and validates service account tokens for critical operators. I'll draft the K8s Job.

jess: Also add a note to the enablement runbook: if playbook-runner gets 403s, check serviceaccount token expiration before escalating to infra. That would've saved ~15 mins.

maya: Agreed. Putting a short incident note in the playbook docs now. Will follow up tomorrow with a postmortem blameless writeup.

cs-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: playbook automation restored at 2026-03-20T19:07:30Z. Root cause: missing rolebinding after KMS key rotation.
